card.name: The word "a" before maximum duration
card.fires_on: The word "a" right after "for" or "to" when a time limit is being set, where "maximum" is likely to come next. Seen in treatment duration and storage-time limits.

modes.label: Duration limit
modes.description: The word "a" after "for" in a limit on treatment length, followed by "maximum of".
modes.example: until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity, for<< a>> maximum of 24 months.

modes.label: Storage time limit
modes.description: The word "a" after "for" in how long a product may be held at a given temperature.
modes.example: may be stored refrigerated between 2 °C to 8 °C (36 °F to 46 °F) for<< a>> maximum of 72 hours or between

modes.label: Stray cases
modes.description: A few other words where a cap or quantity is expected, such as a unit or a count noun.
modes.example: Win2K AS supports two<< nodes>> running Cluster service
